units.label: Verse 1
units.deva:
वेदान्तवाक्येषु सदा रमन्तो भिक्षान्नमात्रेण च तुष्टिमन्तः ।
विशोकवन्तः करणैकवन्तः कौपीनवन्तः खलु भाग्यवन्तः ॥
units.translation: Ever delighting in Vedānta teachings, satisfied with food gained by alms alone, free from grief, and with their faculties gathered into a single focus, the loincloth-wearers are indeed fortunate.

gloss.en: with food gained by alms alone
with the faculties gathered into one focus

units.iast:
vedāntavākyeṣu sadā ramanto bhikṣānnamātreṇa ca tuṣṭimantaḥ |
viśokavantaḥ karaṇaikavantaḥ kaupīnavantaḥ khalu bhāgyavantaḥ ||

units.label: Verse 2
units.deva:
मूलं तरोः केवलमाश्रयन्तः पाणिद्वयं भोक्तुममन्त्रयन्तः ।
कन्थामिव श्रीमपि कुत्सयन्तः कौपीनवन्तः खलु भाग्यवन्तः ॥
units.translation: Taking shelter only at a tree’s base, inviting both hands to serve as a bowl for eating, and scorning even wealth as though it were a patched cloak, the loincloth-wearers are indeed fortunate.
units.iast:
mūlaṃ taroḥ kevalamāśrayantaḥ pāṇidvayaṃ bhoktumamantrayantaḥ |
kanthāmiva śrīmapi kutsayantaḥ kaupīnavantaḥ khalu bhāgyavantaḥ ||

units.label: Verse 3
units.deva:
देहादिभावं परिमार्जयन्त आत्मानमात्मन्यवलोकयन्तः ।
नान्तर्न मध्यं न बहिः स्मरन्तः कौपीनवन्तः खलु भाग्यवन्तः ॥
units.translation: Removing identification with the body and the rest, seeing the Self within the Self, and not thinking in terms of an end, a middle, or an outside, the loincloth-wearers are indeed fortunate.

gloss.en: identification with the body and the rest

units.iast:
dehādibhāvaṃ parimārjayanta ātmānamātmanyavalokayantaḥ |
nāntarna madhyaṃ na bahiḥ smarantaḥ kaupīnavantaḥ khalu bhāgyavantaḥ ||

units.label: Verse 4
units.deva:
स्वानन्दभावे परितुष्टिमन्तः संशान्तसर्वेन्द्रियदृष्टिमन्तः ।
अहर्निशं ब्रह्मणि ये रमन्तः कौपीनवन्तः खलु भाग्यवन्तः ॥
units.translation: Content in the state of their own bliss, with all sensory perception quieted, those who delight in Brahman day and night—the loincloth-wearers are indeed fortunate.

gloss.en: in the state of one’s own bliss

units.iast:
svānandabhāve parituṣṭimantaḥ saṃśāntasarvendriyadṛṣṭimantaḥ |
aharniśaṃ brahmaṇi ye ramantaḥ kaupīnavantaḥ khalu bhāgyavantaḥ ||

units.label: Verse 5
units.deva:
पञ्चाक्षरं पावनमुच्चरन्तः पतिं पशूनां हृदि भावयन्तः ।
भिक्षाशना दिक्षु परिभ्रमन्तः कौपीनवन्तः खलु भाग्यवन्तः ॥
units.translation: Uttering the purifying five-syllable mantra, contemplating in the heart the Lord of all beings, and wandering through the directions while living on alms, the loincloth-wearers are indeed fortunate.
units.iast:
pañcākṣaraṃ pāvanamuccarantaḥ patiṃ paśūnāṃ hṛdi bhāvayantaḥ |
bhikṣāśanā dikṣu paribhramantaḥ kaupīnavantaḥ khalu bhāgyavantaḥ ||

units.label: Closing colophon
units.deva: इति श्रीमत्परमहंसपरिव्राजकाचार्यस्य श्रीगोविन्दभगवत्पूज्यपादशिष्यस्य श्रीमच्छङ्करभगवतः कृतौ यतिपञ्चकं संपूर्णम् ॥
units.translation: Thus the Yatipañcakam is complete: it was composed by the revered Śaṅkara Bhagavat, supreme renunciant and teacher among wandering ascetics, disciple of the worship-worthy feet of Govinda Bhagavat.

gloss.en: of the teacher among wandering ascetics
whose feet are worthy of worship
the five verses on the renunciant

units.iast: iti śrīmatparamahaṃsaparivrājakācāryasya śrīgovindabhagavatpūjyapādaśiṣyasya śrīmacchaṅkarabhagavataḥ kṛtau yatipañcakaṃ saṃpūrṇam ||
